## Project Summary

**What it is:**
A local CLI for a Practical Nurse (PN) study plan — lets you build a remediation plan from your own topic tags and notes, with study progress tracked in plain JSON files locally.

**Rules for anyone working on it:**
- Standard library only (no external dependencies)
- Keep it local, no network access
- Plain JSON storage only (no database)
- **Never** include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan) — topic tags and personal notes only
- All plan content must stay within PN scope of practice (reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan)
- Don't package or publish (personal use only)
- Keep output format and behavior unchanged
- Balance study days so no day has more than two topics from the same client need; include tests for this

**Still owed before sharing:**
- A review by someone with a nursing background checking **every** plan template for proper PN scope-of-practice wording — this hasn't happened yet and is flagged in `scope_review.json`
